name: flickering-grid
title: Flickering Grid
blurb: Canvas grid of squares that flicker independently at random intervals.
description: Canvas-based grid where each square randomly flickers between transparent and opaque. Runs only when visible via IntersectionObserver; ResizeObserver keeps it responsive.
use_when: A subtle, performance-conscious background that adds visual interest without demanding resources when off-screen.
avoid_when: Requires a container with fixed dimensions or CSS flex/grid sizing. Very small grid gaps may impact performance.
a11y: Decorative canvas overlay; focus and keyboard behaviour come from children. Flickering has no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
